description: A lab-local CSRF: the profile update endpoint accepts a cross-origin POST with no token.

evidence.request: POST https://lab.local/profile {display_name: pwned} from origin https://lab.evil.test
evidence.notes: Lab-local fixture traffic only; the victim profile was restored after the test

impact: An attacker could change a lab user's profile by getting them to open a lab page.
proof_of_concept: A lab page that auto-submits POST /lab/profile {display_name: pwned} from another lab origin changes the victim display name; the request log shows the cross-origin POST.
remediation: Require a per-session CSRF token on state-changing POSTs.
steps_to_reproduce: Log in as a lab user
Open the lab page that auto-submits the profile form from another origin
title: CSRF on lab profile update
